_comment: This deployable catalog covers nine registered strategies: smoke_atm_roundtrip, reddit_sentiment_qqq, trump_whisperer_qqq, momentum_qqq, max_pain_qqq, oi_skew_qqq, put_call_ratio_qqq, canopus_down_day_14, and looking_glass_straddle. Canopus implements the frozen Down-Day 14 forward-test rule: capture a trustworthy 09:30 ET reference, buy one ATM 0DTE put during 14:45-14:51 only when QQQ is down at least 0.25%, sell when the live bid reaches 1.14x the fill (rounded up to the next cent), or liquidate at 15:45. Do not retune it from individual outcomes. looking_glass_straddle (alias 'Cheshire' below) is a provisional-research direction-neutral 0DTE QQQ opening straddle -- buy num_straddles ATM calls+puts at entry_time_et, sell core_sell_count of each leg the first time the position's live value reaches C0*(1+core_profit_threshold_pct), and let the N-k runner ride uncapped to terminal_exit_time_et (or liquidate everything there on a no-touch day); no re-entry once a day's sequence has traded. See crassus/strategies/looking_glass_straddle.py's module docstring for why entry/exit are unavoidably two legs across separate runner cycles (Decision only ever places one symbol per cycle) and for why the params below are one representative point in the strategy brief's own validation sweep, not a tuned result. Passwords come from the listed environment variables; the runner rejects unregistered strategies and missing credentials at startup.
_runtime_note: This tracked file is the default bot catalog. An ignored accounts.json overlays matching usernames and may add private accounts; it does not replace or hide catalog entries.
